name: Availability overlap
use_when: finding a day or time that works for everyone
days or times were mentioned in the chat
dont_use_when: the time is set and the question is who comes (use lock)
guarantees: each person is in a cell at most once
a tap changes only the tapper in that cell
a pick is always a cell with the most people, and it freezes the grid until anyone undoes it
a leaver's taps go and lift a pick they changed; a late joiner can tap at once

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'When can everyone hang?'

days.description: Columns: days or dates from the chat, 1 to 7, short like 'Fri' or 'Sat 14'

times.description: Rows: times of day, 1 to 5, short like 'Lunch' or '7 PM'
